build.buildCommand: npx prisma generate && npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.7.71 browser ensure && rm -rf /app/.chrome && cp -r /root/.cache/hyperframes /app/.chrome && find /app/.chrome -type f -name chrome-headless-shell | head -1 > /app/.chrome-path && cat /app/.chrome-path

deploy.startCommand: npx prisma migrate deploy && npm run db:seed && npm run start
